visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white historical-style engraving depicting a chaotic battle scene between Native American warriors and men in Western-style clothing, possibly soldiers or settlers. The scene is set in a wooded or rocky area with smoke filling the air. In the foreground, a warrior on horseback is visible, while in the background, hand-to-hand combat occurs near what appears to be a train or a wooden structure. The composition is dense with figures, weapons, and action.
